summary: The comment opposes cutting the E-Rate program, citing its impact on public schools and libraries and the burden on local government budgets.

claims.argument: Cutting E-Rate would have devastating impact on public schools and libraries
claims.evidence_quote: Please do not cut or reduce the E-rate program, as it would have a devastating impact on public schools and libraries across the country and further burden local government with additional costs in a time when municipal budgets are already stretched extremely thin.
